title: Employee Profile and Personal Information
scope: Applies to Business Analysts during their first 30 days.
summary: Defines the employee details required during onboarding.
details: Required profile data includes employee code, name, email, role, department, manager, mentor, joining date, location, experience level and onboarding day.
Employees must verify profile accuracy on Day 1.
Sensitive identifiers must not be entered in chat or ordinary ticket descriptions.
Changes must be timestamped and auditable.
escalation: Raise an HR Policy ticket if mandatory details cannot be corrected.
exceptions: Any exception requires documented approval from the policy owner.
